claims.author: ismaelsadeeq
claims.quote: We can reduce a bit of redundancy by not sending them again to the peers that announced them to us.
claims.request: Avoid sending prefilled extrapool transactions back to the peers that announced them

status_by.quote: Even if a peer has sent us a transaction that ends up in our extrapool, they may not have it in their mempool now

claims.status_note: author explained that transactions might have been evicted or RBF'd and per-peer tracking adds high complexity

claims.author: 0xB10C
claims.quote: An idea mentioned in the delving post was to log information about wasted prefill bandwidth on the receiving side.
claims.request: Log information about wasted prefill bandwidth on the receiving side

status_by.quote: That's a great point, I had logic for this in my observation nodes, but I've incorporated the changes into this PR.

claims.status_note: author added redundant prefill logging to the PR

claims.author: 0xB10C
claims.harm: Logging all required transactions in non-test settings could cause log rate-limiting
claims.quote: Could this cause log rate-limiting? Maybe a good use for the trace log level?

status_by.quote: Trace and Debug level logs are not rate limited

claims.status_note: author replied noting trace and debug logs are not rate limited, and switched to trace logging

claims.author: johnnyasantoss
claims.quote: Since we are just reading the send_state why not prefer WITH_LOCK?

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.quote: I think we can hoist cb_fut and prefilled_cb_fut out and copy the shared futures while m_most_recent_block_mutex is held, then release the lock for the rest of this method.
claims.request: Hoist cb_fut and prefilled_cb_fut out to release m_most_recent_block_mutex before executing syscalls

status_by.quote: Nice! Much better to not hold a lock that prevents block updates while doing syscalls!!

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.quote: I don't think we should be switching the serialization from std::launch::deferred to std::launch::async.
claims.request: Avoid switching serialization launch policy from deferred to async

status_by.quote: Yeah, sorry if it's weird to combine both changes in one commit, I can split up if you think that makes sense.

claims.status_note: reviewer edited to note eager background serialization makes sense for prefill, and author asked if resolved

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.question: When will the block hash in prefill_candidates differ from hash, and can they be merged?
claims.quote: When will the block hash in prefill_candidates differ from hash above? Can these be merged?

status_by.quote: right now the issue is that we'll update the prefill candidates on reconstruction, but the block might still fail somewhere in ProcessBlock()

claims.status_note: author explained candidates update on reconstruction but the block might still fail in ProcessBlock

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.quote: We log window_size and bytes_available here, but we also log them on the call side. Can we remove one of the logs?
claims.request: Remove duplicate logging of window_size and bytes_available

status_by.quote: Ok, I removed it on the caller side.

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.harm: Seeding prefill candidates with the coinbase forces unnecessary TCP syscalls and prefill branch execution even when no extra transactions are prefilled
claims.quote: In that case, the check in net_processing for prefill_candidates.size() > 0 is always true, so we will always go through the prefill path and do all the syscalls even for the current behavior of alway

status_by.quote: Great catch, thank you, I took this by changing the check to be prefill_candidates.size() > 1

claims.status_note: author changed the condition to require more than one candidate

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.quote: we should take m_send_mutex lock and return the value if send_state != SendState::v1, and then return the fallback after releasing the lock.
claims.request: Avoid taking and releasing m_send_mutex multiple times by returning early

status_by.quote: Taken thanks, this also made me realize GetMessageHeaderSize shouldn't be virtual, public, or take a lock, so fixed that as well.

claims.status_note: author refactored lock handling and header size method

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.harm: Use-after-free by resetting txn_available before retrieving its size
claims.quote: This is a use-after-free. We need to get the size before we reset it 3 lines above.

status_by.quote: Thanks for catching, sorry the quality of this logging commit was low when I pushed it.

claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.harm: Logging fails to increment prefilled_size and fails to adjust extra_size
claims.quote: Also need prefilled_size += tx_size; We don't increment/decrement extra_size either. Seems like an oversight?

status_by.quote: Thanks for catching, sorry this went out broken.

claims.status_note: author acknowledged and resolved logging omissions

claims.question: Why redundant mempool stats are handled under a not-in-mempool condition
claims.quote: why inside this condition !pool->exists(tx_wtxid) which means "not in mempool", there's a mempool variable redundant_prefilled_mp_... handling?

status_by.quote: I'll let both my comments open, although I see they are fixed in #35724.

claims.status_note: fixed when logging was extracted into PR 35724 and rebased

claims.author: m4ycon
claims.harm: prefilled_size is never incremented, resulting in inaccurate reconstruction log stats
claims.quote: the value is always zero. Which could not be true in any scenario as coinbase is always prefilled. I couldn't find any assignment to it, probably it's a simple fix.

status_by.quote: Thanks, I've rebased this on #35724, so marking as resolved.
